title: Havenline animal meat concept expansion

assets.label: DEER MEAT
assets.design: One boneless lean elongated haunch pickup, a low rounded asymmetric wedge of rich cranberry-red meat. The left end in FRONT0 is broad and blunt, the right end tapers smoothly but stays thick. Length about twice width, thickness about one-third width. No full cream rim: only one thin continuous cream seam along the FRONT broad side just below the top edge, and one small oval cream fat spot on top near the blunt LEFT end. Broad subtly sculpted planes, no fine marbling. This silhouette must be a lean tapering haunch, clearly different from a round steak or rectangular processed meat block. Zero bones. Top fat spot remains at blunt end in every panel.

assets.label: BOAR MEAT
assets.design: One thick raw bone-in chop pickup with a broad rounded triangular/teardrop silhouette, salmon-red muscle and a thick cream fat cap along the REAR long edge only. At FRONT0 the left end is broad, the right end is slightly narrower. ONE small oval cream bone cross-section lies flush in the TOP face near the narrow RIGHT end, containing one small warm beige marrow center; never add a projecting bone, second bone or extra piece. The top muscle has only one broad shallow curved groove near the broad left end. Soft chunky edges and sculpted broad planes. It is a thick chop, not thin generic steak or ham leg. assets.label: RABBIT MEAT
assets.design: A small paired saddle-portion pickup: exactly TWO separate boneless smooth blush-red rounded oblong pieces, parallel along the left-right long axis, side by side front-to-back, close but with a visible narrow gap. The FRONT piece is slightly longer and thicker; the REAR piece is about80% its length. Their left ends are rounded, right ends gently tapered. Each piece has exactly ONE simple thin cream seam running along its top length; no extra bones, no full fat rims, no third piece. Treat the two pieces as one rigid arranged resource unit: same gap and same fore/aft order from every angle, never rearrange. FRONT0 shows longer front piece partly occluding the smaller rear piece; FRONT RIGHT45 shows tapered RIGHT ends nearer lowerRIGHT; RIGHT90 shows two tapered ends side by side in depth-projected arrangement; REAR RIGHT135 tapered ends nearer lowerLEFT; REAR180 smaller rear piece now nearer viewer, longer behind; REAR LEFT225 rounded LEFT ends nearer lowerRIGHT; LEFT270 looks directly at two rounded left ends; FRONT LEFT315 rounded LEFT ends nearer lowerLEFT. 45/225 share top-left to bottom-right long-axis diagonal;135/315 share bottom-left to top-right diagonal. Maintain exact two-piece count and physically coherent overlaps. Gentle broad stylized meat material, clearly smaller/finer than deer or boar yet comfortably sized within panels.

assets.label: MOOSE MEAT
assets.design: ONE broad, heavy raw shank-cut pickup: a very thick flattened oval chunk of dark wine-red meat, length1.6 times width and thickness0.65 times width. Slightly lobed rounded polygon perimeter; the LEFT end in FRONT0 is fuller, the RIGHT end has ONE shallow semicircular notch. ONE large circular ivory bone cross-section is embedded flush into the TOP slightly left of center, with ONE smaller muted beige marrow center; one bone only. A short thick cream fat patch covers only the rear-left upper edge, not a full perimeter ring. Broad clean sculpted muscle planes, no thin photographic marbling. This is markedly thicker, more massive and rounder than deer haunch and boar chop. assets.label: SQUIRREL MEAT
assets.design: Exactly TWO compact lean meat morsels as one rigid loose pair, visually distinct from the longer rabbit saddle portions. Each is a small thick rounded triangular nugget, not a thin slice: deep rosy-red meat with broad polished facets and no bones, no cream rim, no longitudinal stripes. The slightly larger nugget sits at the LEFT in FRONT0, the smaller sits at RIGHT with a narrow visible gap; their centers lie along the resource's left-right axis. The larger LEFT nugget alone has ONE tiny flat oval cream speck at its upper FRONT edge. Smaller nugget is plain. Both have a softly flattened base and softly domed top, same proportions and gap in all8 views. assets.label: WILD BEAR MEAT
assets.design: ONE broad, fatty rectangular rib-cut pickup, gently curved and softly beveled, about twice as long LEFT-to-RIGHT as front-to-rear width, quite thick. Burgundy-red broad muscle planes and one broad smooth ivory fat cap over the REAR half of the top face. Exactly THREE short blunt ivory rib tips project just a little from the FRONT long edge at equal spacing; no skeletal rack, no long bones, no gore. The rib tips are rounded small rectangular nubs integrated into one red meat slab, and their arrangement is fixed. LEFT end is squared-round; RIGHT end has ONE slightly clipped upper corner. The cream top cap has one small red notch near LEFT end, a stable landmark. FRONT0 shows three front rib tips, left rounded end/right clipped end.45 sees clipped RIGHT end near lowerRIGHT, rib tips along foregroundLEFT face.90 direct RIGHT narrow end: rib tips are only edge projections on imageLEFT.135 rear-right sees broad smooth rear face and clipped end near lowerLEFT, rib tips largely hidden.180 rear broadface, clipped endLEFT, no rib tips facingcamera.225 rear-left sees rounded LEFT end near lowerRIGHT, broad rear face imageLEFT, tips hidden except edge.270 direct LEFT end, front rib tips at imageRIGHT edge.315 front-left sees rounded LEFT end near lowerLEFT and three front rib tips. Keep exactly one slab, one broad fat cap, three short rib tips, one small cap notch, same geometry in all views. It is an optional wild-animal ART PROPOSAL; no companion animal or animal figure appears.

assets.label: WILD WOLF MEAT
assets.design: ONE long, lean, straight boneless loin pickup, like a softly faceted flattened cylinder of deep burgundy-red meat, length3 times width, with constant substantial thickness. It is neither wedge-shaped nor round steak: both ends blunt, LEFT end a softly slanted cut plane, RIGHT end a nearly square rounded cut plane with ONE small shallow notch in its upper corner. Exactly ONE very thin ivory tendon seam runs along the FRONT lower long edge, stopping before both ends. The TOP has ONE broad shallow longitudinal sculpted groove, no other cream spots or stripes. Zero bones, no fat cap. assets.label: WILD FOX MEAT
assets.design: ONE slender curved boneless loin pickup, a clean shallow crescent of rich muted rosy-red meat with softly rounded chunky crosssection. Length about3 times width. In FRONT0 it curves gently away from viewer, so FRONT long edge is concave and REAR long edge convex; LEFT end is blunt and rounded, RIGHT end subtly tapers but never to needlepoint. No bones, no full cream rim. Exactly ONE narrow ivory crescent-shaped tendon patch is fixed at the upper LEFT blunt-end corner and follows the start of the concave front edge for only a short distance. Remainder is plain red with a few broad sculpted muscle planes. Clearly more curved and slender than straight wolf loin and heavy wedge-shaped deer haunch. assets.label: LYNX MEAT
assets.design: Exactly TWO compact thick round boneless medallions forming a rigid two-piece resource unit, placed side by side LEFT-to-RIGHT with a narrow visible gap. They are nearly equal diameter but the LEFT medallion in FRONT0 is slightly taller. Each is a short red cylinder with softly beveled edges, thickness about0.45 of diameter, flat top and broad sculpted deep crimson muscle planes. ONE short gently curving ivory slash sits on the top of the LEFT taller medallion only; RIGHT shorter medallion is plain red. Both have a very thin cream fat band only along the lower SIDE circumference, never across the top and never bone rings. No bones. This must read as two compact round steak medallions, distinct from triangular squirrel nuggets and elongated rabbit pieces. assets.label: WOLVERINE MEAT
assets.design: ONE chunky boneless raw shoulder cut pickup, a compact high irregular rounded block of dark cherry-red muscle, length1.5 times width, height about0.9 times width. FRONT0 silhouette has a high broad LEFT shoulder and a slightly lower narrower RIGHT shoulder. The top is two broad connected rounded muscle lobes separated by ONE shallow transverse valley, not separate pieces. Exactly ONE short diagonal cream seam crosses the FRONT upper-left broad side only, stopping before edges; the back is plain. The RIGHT narrow end has ONE small softly clipped upper corner; LEFT end broad and nearly vertical. No bones, no cream fatcap, no full perimeter rim. This must read as a tall compact shoulder chunk, visually distinct from low deer wedge, long wolfloin, curved foxloin, round bone-in moose shank and any paired morsels.
